v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: Dum esset Rex * in accúbitu suo, nardus mea dedit odórem suavitátis.
text.en: While the King sitteth at his table, * my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.

text.la: Læva eius * sub cápite meo, et déxtera illíus amplexábitur me.
text.en: His left hand is under my head, * and his right hand doth embrace me.

text.la: Nigra sum, * sed formósa, fíliæ Ierúsalem; ídeo diléxit me Rex, et introdúxit me in cubículum suum.
text.en: I am black but comely, * O ye daughters of Jerusalem; therefore hath the King loved me, and brought me into his chamber.

text.la: Iam hiems tránsiit, * imber ábiit et recéssit: surge, amíca mea, et veni.
text.en: Lo the winter is past, * the rain is over and gone. Rise up, my love, and come away.

text.la: Speciósa * facta es et suávis in delíciis tuis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
text.en: O Holy Mother of God, thou art become beautiful * and gentle in thy gladness.

text.la: Ab inítio et ante sǽcula creáta sum, et usque ad futúrum sǽculum non désinam, et in habitatióne sancta coram ipso ministrávi.
text.en: From the beginning, and before the world, was I created, and unto the world to come I shall not cease to be, and in the holy dwelling place I have ministered before him.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: O beáta Virgo * María: tu grátiæ Mater, tu spes mundi, exáudi nos fílios tuos clamántes ad te.
text.en: O Blessed Virgin * Mary: thou Mother of grace, thou hope of the world, hear us, thy children, who cry to thee.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui in Corde beátæ Maríæ Vírginis dignum Spíritus Sancti habitáculum præparásti: concéde propítius; ut eiúsdem immaculáti Cordis festivitátem devóta mente recoléntes, secúndum Cor tuum vívere valeámus.
text.en: Almighty everlasting God, who hast prepared in the heart of Blessed Virgin Mary a worthy dwelling of the Holy Ghost, grant favourably to us that we may keep the feast of the same Immaculate Heart devoutly, and may be able to live according to thy heart.

title.la: Ss. Timothei, Hippolyti et Symphoriani Martyres
title.en: Sts. Timothy, Hippolytus and Symphorianus, Martyrs

text.la: Vestri capílli cápitis omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
text.en: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Auxílium tuum nobis, Dómine, quǽsumus, placátus impende: et, intercedéntibus beátis Martýribus tuis Timótheo, Hippólyto et Symphoriáno, déxteram super nos tuæ propitiatiónis exténde.
text.en: Mercifully help us, O Lord, we beseech thee, and at the pleading of thine holy Martyrs Timothy, Hippolytus, and Symphorian, stretch forth over us the right hand of thy favour.
